items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes (40–200 µL) handled by p300 within range, labware loaded with the required labels, and no overdispense or empty-well check failed.
Every transfer uses new_tip='always' (a fresh tip per well), the checks tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end pass, and reset_tipracks keeps tips available.
All 13 steps appear in order with the correct volumes, mix counts and comments for the non-simulated steps, and nothing extra is added.
The loop does p300.transfer(40, beads, well, mix_after=(10,40)) for all 96 wells, then comments the 5 min incubation before the magnet.
The magnet comment comes first, then 90 µL is removed per well to waste, then two 200 µL ethanol adds each followed by a 200 µL removal to waste.
Comments cover the 5 min air dry, magnet disengage and 2 min incubation with magnet re-engage; 50 µL water is added with mix_after=(10,50).
p300.transfer(45, sample_wells, elution_wells, new_tip='always') pairs wells in order, and the end_state:elution_plate check passes.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the task steps in order with correct volumes, a fresh tip for every well, and all measured checks passing. The non-simulated steps are recorded as protocol.comment calls, as the task requires.
